name: hairloom
description: Standalone local-first hairstyle exploration and front-side-back Design Lock application.

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check src/exploreCore.mjs && node --check src/consultationCore.mjs && node --check src/trendRegistry.mjs && node --check src/hairTrendData.mjs && node --check consultation/app.mjs && node --check scripts/generateHairDesignCatalog.mjs && node --check scripts/generateHairMasterCatalog.mjs && node --check scripts/syncHairTrends.mjs && node --check scripts/manageHairTrendSchedule.mjs && node --check scripts/checkHairTrendCadence.mjs && node --check scripts/checkHairTrendChanges.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const file of ['index.html','consultation/index.html'].filter(fs.existsSync)){const html=fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8');const scripts=[...html.matchAll(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/g)];for(const [,source] of scripts)new Function(source);console.log('HTML scripts parsed:',file,scripts.length)}"
scripts.test: node --test server.test.mjs exploreCore.test.mjs consultationCore.test.mjs catalogRuntime.test.mjs trendRegistry.test.mjs trendSchedule.test.mjs trendAutomation.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run catalog:check && npm run master-catalog:check && npm run trend:check && npm test
